intro: In Elwynn Forest, Billy Maclure wants a pie from the Stonefield farm before he speaks about a missing necklace. Auntie Bernice Stonefield bakes it despite the feud between their families.

p: The Stonefield and Maclure families have quarreled over land and pride for years in Elwynn Forest. Young Billy Maclure has a weakness for Auntie Bernice's pork belly pie. When a valuable Stonefield family necklace goes missing, Billy refuses to share what he knows until an adventurer brings him a warm slice. Bernice bakes the pie reluctantly, wishing the greedy boy would choke on it.
